Hymn 111: Rock of Ages
Time Signature: 3/4
Musical Key: B-flat Major

This is hymn number 111 titled "Rock of Ages" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in B-flat Major with a 3/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Thomas Hastings and the lyrics were written by Augustus M. Toplady.
This hymn is categorized under: Prayer and Supplication.
